title: Binance Margin: New Convert Option for Close Position
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, After  2026-06-17 10:00 (UTC) ,  Binance Margin  will gradually release a new Convert option for the Close Position function through a grayscale release. This enhancement provides users with an additional, easier way to settle their positions and repay outstanding debt.  Key Updates: New Convert Option:  When closing a position, users can now choose to sell their assets via Convert and receive the settlement currency directly. For orders with a large amount, Convert offers a better price with lower slippage compared to placing a Market Order. Two Transaction Methods:  The Close Position flow will present two parallel options — Convert and Market Order. Market Order remains available, where the amount received may vary due to slippage. Grayscale Release:  This feature will be released progressively across Web and App through a grayscale rollout. As a result, the feature will become available to different users at different times, and you may not see it immediately after the release date. Guides & Related Materials: What Is Margin Trading How to Use the Close Position and Repay Functions on Binance Margin? Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-16
